prompt: Create an intimate close-up portrait of a young woman with a stylized semi-realistic CGI/anime-realism look blended with photographic skin detail. She has deep crimson red shoulder-length messy hair swept across her forehead, loose strands framing her face, pale skin, large glossy hazel-green eyes, long lashes, dark winged eyeliner, softly arched worried eyebrows, a small nose, and slightly parted natural pink lips. Her expression is shy, anxious, and tender, looking slightly off to the viewer’s right rather than directly at the camera. Add visible anime-style blush marks: exactly 18 diagonal pink strokes across both cheeks and the bridge of the nose, with 8 strokes on the viewer-left cheek area, 2 shorter strokes over the nose bridge, and 8 strokes on the viewer-right cheek area. Frame her from bare shoulders upward in a tight vertical portrait, face filling most of the canvas, with the top of the hair close to the upper edge and shoulders softly visible at the bottom. Use shallow depth of field, soft moody indoor lighting from the upper left, subtle catchlights in the eyes, realistic pores and skin texture, gentle subsurface scattering, cinematic contrast, muted dark gray-brown background blur, and a high-end character-render-meets-photography finish. Keep the image clean with no text, no accessories, and no extra characters.

promptZh: 创作一张亲密的特写肖像，主角为 一位年轻女性，采用风格化的半写实 CGI/动漫写实风格，并融合摄影级的皮肤细节。她拥有 深绯红色 的齐肩凌乱短发，发丝扫过前额，几缕碎发修饰脸庞；皮肤白皙，有着明亮的大眼睛，呈榛绿色，睫毛修长，画着深色上扬眼线，眉毛微微拱起，流露出担忧的神情，鼻子小巧，双唇自然粉嫩且微微张开。她的表情害羞、焦虑而温柔，视线略微偏向观察者的右侧，而非直视镜头。添加明显的动漫风格腮红：双颊和鼻梁上共有 18 条斜向粉色笔触，其中观察者左侧脸颊 8 条，鼻梁 2 条短笔触，观察者右侧脸颊 8 条。构图采用紧凑的竖向肖像，从裸露的肩膀向上取景，脸部占据大部分画面，发顶靠近上边缘，肩膀在底部隐约可见。使用浅景深，左上方柔和的室内情绪光，眼睛带有细腻的眼神光，呈现真实的毛孔和皮肤纹理、柔和的次表面散射、电影级对比度，背景为柔和的深灰棕色模糊效果，打造出高端角色渲染与摄影结合的质感。保持画面整洁，无文字、无配饰，且无其他额外角色。
